text: Among ERC Starting Grant projects that use eye-tracking, which one studies age-related cognitive decline in a non-human animal rather than in people?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT p.id FROM project p WHERE (p.objective ILIKE '%eye-tracking%' OR p.objective ILIKE '%eye tracking%') AND p.fundingScheme = 'ERC-STG' ORDER BY p.id

reference_answer: EVOLOR (project 680040) is the one: this ERC Starting Grant studies cognitive ageing in dogs rather than in people, treating the dog as a natural animal model and building a standardized behaviour test battery for early detection, with eye-tracking used alongside motion path analysis, inertial sensors, EEG, fMRI and genetics.
notes: Filter: fundingScheme = 'ERC-STG' plus an objective LIKE on the method term (eye-tracking / eye tracking); 9 survivors, enumerated. The runtime scoped path can only carry the structural half (fundingScheme, whitelisted in src/retrieval/scoped.py); the method and the subject matter fall to retrieval. Adjudication against this wording, exhaustive over all 9 survivors: 680040 EVOLOR IN - 'the cognitive decline during senescence', 'characterising the ageing phenotype ... in dogs as a well-established natural animal model', 'eye-tracking' named among its methods. OUT: 636458 CogSoCoAGE (humans 10 to 80+); 679010 STATLEARN (human readers; rats appear only as a comparison in workPerformed, and the question is reading, not ageing); 758813 MHINT (mother-child dyads); 802905 INFOSAMPLE (human multiattribute choice); 802979 EMPORIGIN (the only other non-human-animal survivor - bonobo and human INFANT development of empathy, not age-related decline); 852885 INDIVISUAL (human gaze behaviour); 948545 TrackingMinds (human Theory of Mind); 948671 INFORL (human reinforcement learning). Filter load-bearing - out-of-filter projects that satisfy this text and are excluded only by the funding scheme: 709015 AGE-MEMORY (MSCA-IF-EF-ST) 'age-related memory impairment (AMI). We will use both C. elegans and Drosophila as experimental platforms', unscoped lexical rank 1 (EVOLOR lexical 3); 665335 Dementia (ERC-POC) mouse models of accelerated neurodegeneration for Alzheimer therapeutics, unscoped hybrid_rerank rank 1 (EVOLOR 2); 708466 'Microbiota and aging' (MSCA-IF-EF-ST) 'swapping the gut-microbiota from aged mice into young mice ... contribution of the gut-microbiota in the cognitive decline ... associated with aging'; 708563 GLYCONEOBRAIN (MSCA-IF) 'degenerative hippocampal granules in aged mice'. term_style exact-term, recomputed from the gold's stored text: EVOLOR's objective contains 'eye-tracking' and 'cognitive decline', its finalResults contains 'age-related cognitive and behavioural differences', and it is lexical rank 1 inside the scope. Scoped rank matrix over the 9 survivors: EVOLOR 1/1/1/1 (lexical/dense/hybrid/hybrid_rerank). Candidate counts from the scoped search; adjudication from the exhaustive read.

text: Among ERC Starting Grant projects on nanoscale light control, which one set out to do away with the lenses and reflectors added onto low-energy lamps by placing the light-emitting nanoparticles inside engineered surroundings - stacked layers, patterned surfaces and resonant cavities - so that the tint and the beam spread of the light are fixed by those surroundings rather than by changing what the particles themselves are made of?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID = p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocPath LIKE '%/nanophotonics%' AND p.fundingScheme = 'ERC-STG'

reference_answer: NANOPHOM (project 715832) is the ERC Starting Grant in question: it puts rare-earth nanophosphors inside engineered optical structures - multilayers, surface textures, nano-scatterers, nanoimprinted corrugations and optical cavities - and shows that those surroundings alone set the chromaticity and the directionality of the device's output, 'without modifying the chemical composition of the emitters', replacing the reflectors and lenses normally added as secondary optical elements. Its target demonstrations were directional white-light emission within a narrow angular cone and omnidirectional emission of monochromatic light.
notes: FILTER: euroSciVoc leaf 'nanophotonics' (one-reading check: 'engineering and technology/nanotechnology/nanophotonics' is the only path matching '%nanophotonics%', 62 projects) intersected with fundingScheme='ERC-STG' -> 10 survivors, re-executed this pass. Runtime note: the scoped path (src/retrieval/scoped.py) can only filter the structural half ('ERC Starting Grant' -> fundingScheme='ERC-STG'); the nanophotonics topic is carried by retrieval, which is how the question is worded. LOW note on scope width: the enumerated survivor set is narrower than the runtime's executable scope (all ERC-STG projects), so ERC-STG projects tagged under other euroSciVoc leaves - e.g. 849229 CQWLED (nanocrystals / colors / optoelectronics) - are reachable at runtime but not enumerated here; CQWLED is excluded by the question's own words (see ADJUDICATION), so this is a recorded width note, not a gold gap. ADJUDICATION (exhaustive, all 10 survivors read at objective+teaser, gold at full payload; re-adjudicated against the current wording): 715832 NANOPHOM IN - 'exploits new ways of controlling the emission characteristics of nanophosphors, surpassing the limits imposed by conventional optics', design 'based on multilayers, surface textures and nano-scatterers', and the report states the control comes 'without modifying the chemical composition of the emitters', with reflectors and lenses named as the secondary optical elements being replaced. OUT: 637116 ENLIGHTMENT (photonic electrodes to enhance light ABSORPTION in thin solar cells, photodetectors, sensors); 639109 FLATLIGHT (visible-wavelength metasurfaces as ultrathin reconfigurable optical components and modulators, not emission from a lamp's emitting particles); 677470 SEAQUEL (cold structured atomic ensembles for quantum engineering of light); 679841 ORDERin1D (chirality-sorted carbon nanotubes, molecular filling and order); 714151 PSINFONI (particle-surface near-field interactions, optical and Casimir forces); 802682 MODES (nonlinear multimode processes in fibres, chips and nanoparticles); 802986 aQUARiUM (epsilon-near-zero rolled-up metamaterials for quantum light-matter interaction); 853500 NanoGraphy (plasmon-enhanced photocatalytic nanolithography); 948804 CHANSON (chiral semiconductor nanophotonics for molecular sensing). NEAR-MISSES EXCLUDED BY THE QUESTION'S OWN WORDS: 798697 NEXTLEDs is titled 'Chemical Engineering of Atomically-Flat Colloidal Quantum Wells' and works by synthesizing the emitters themselves - the mechanism the question explicitly rules out - and is MSCA-IF, failing the scheme filter too; 849229 CQWLED likewise guides 'chemistry and shape' of its nanocrystals, never opposes itself to lenses or reflectors (its foils are total internal reflection and EQE), and its 'layers' are the emitter superlattices rather than engineered surroundings. DISCRIMINATION (unscoped pooled k=10 on the current question text): 657434 PhoLED (MSCA-IF-EF-ST) satisfies the textual ask outright and ranks dense 1 / hybrid 1 - 'integrating novel optical nanostructures and emitters, such as colloidal quantum dots or nanophosphors ... preparation and processing strategies, based on surface textures and colloidal scatterers, to attain large area optical nanostructures ... precise control on the intensity, angular distribution and color quality of light emission' - and it fails the ERC-STG filter, so dropping the filter changes the answer. TEXT SIDE: no stored column records what a project does with light emission; the filter alone leaves 10 candidates. TERM-STYLE paraphrase: the question uses 'tint', 'beam spread', 'low-energy lamps', 'stacked layers', 'patterned surfaces', 'resonant cavities' and avoids the gold's distinctive vocabulary (nanophosphor, LED, photonic, solid-state lighting, chromaticity, directionality, spectral, angular, integrated photonic systems). Unscoped on the current wording the lexical condition did NOT return 715832 in its top-10 (lexical rank 1 was 896410 OPAN) while dense ranked it 2, hybrid 3 and hybrid_rerank 2. Scoped lexical rank 1 is uninformative because the scope holds only 10 projects, so every survivor ranks in every condition.

text: Among the Marie Sklodowska-Curie individual fellowships whose stated aim is to study working memory, how do the ones concerned with ageing investigate it in older adults?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT p.id FROM project p WHERE (p.objective ILIKE '%working memory%' OR p.title ILIKE '%working memory%') AND p.fundingScheme LIKE 'MSCA-IF%' ORDER BY p.id

reference_answer: Three of the 18 Marie Sklodowska-Curie individual fellowships whose stated aim is working memory are built around ageing, and each comes at it differently. NeWMaBIL records magnetoencephalography (MEG) from young and old adult bilinguals to test whether bilingualism works as a cognitive reserve for working-memory control, and reports that ageing reduces the attentional and working memory abilities while bilingual proficiency shows no reliable relation with the neural oscillatory modulation. Motivageing applies the Motivation-Cognition Interaction (MoCoInt) framework to healthy older adults and to Parkinson's disease patients, combining multimodal functional neuroimaging with a new working-memory training procedure and a randomised controlled drug trial aimed at raising working-memory capacity. COMEDM asks whether working memory and decision-making run on one shared neural circuit, using recurrent neural network modelling, EEG decoding and pupillometry, and carries the same paradigm over to older adults, where preliminary data indicate that degraded sensory encoding is a dominant source of age-related increase in WM and DM error.
notes: Scope wording: 'whose stated aim is to study working memory' matches the filter's topic clause (objective or title), and deliberately excludes fellowships that merely ran a working-memory task while reporting - 655423 NIBSAD (stated aim: 'visuospatial attention and cognitive control processes'; tDCS working-memory task on eighteen healthy elderly in its report) and 844246 AGEING PLASTICITY (stated aim: prefrontal plasticity and resilience against cognitive ageing; retro-cue working memory task in its report) are out of scope by the question's own words. Filter: fundingScheme LIKE 'MSCA-IF%' (covers MSCA-IF, MSCA-IF-EF-ST, MSCA-IF-GF; no MSCA-PF scheme exists in this corpus) AND working memory in objective or title; 18 survivors, inside the 5-20 filter-synthesize window. The runtime scoped path can only filter the structural half (fundingScheme); the topical half falls to retrieval, which is how the question is worded. Adjudication was EXHAUSTIVE over all 18 survivors (S<=20), not pooled; the scoped pooled search was run only for retrievability and the rank matrix (14 distinct projects returned). IN: 657255 NeWMaBIL - title states working memory control in aged bilinguals, MEG in young vs old adults, cognitive reserve in ageing; 749084 Motivageing - objective states the aim as enhancement of working memory capacity in healthy older adults and Parkinson's patients; 843158 COMEDM - title states decision-making and working memory in health and old age, extended to healthy older adults. OUT: 655374 ACCESS2WM (MEG, prior brain states and access to WM, healthy volunteers, no ageing); 700031 MORE-or-LESS (WM in mental arithmetic, children and adults); 703456 BrainCrossTalk (attention/inhibition oscillations; the single ageing token is a motivational aside, 'in pathological ageing'); 705630 PreMotive (MPFC-DLPFC interaction, EEG-fMRI); 705887 PtoACons (visual consciousness); 707141 MMPCURSRT (rehearsal in 210 children aged 6-10); 707312 GENEVA (DAT1/COMT genetics, attentional control and WM capacity); 753296 StressPFCog (glucocorticoid receptor, chronic stress, mice); 835767 InstrAct (instruction following); 838203 NumBraInf (number processing in infants; grant terminated after 17 days); 888270 SERWOM (serotonergic regulation of WM, mice); 892772 PIANISM (serotonin modulation of PFC circuits, mice); 893275 RootsofWorkingMemory (monkeys, apes, humans); 898460 PFCmap (mouse PFC circuit development); 101030415 ReWoMeN (deep-neural-network modelling of WM recall). Discrimination (filter load-bearing): projects that satisfy the textual ask but fail the scheme filter - 636458 CogSoCoAGE (ERC-STG, intervention to enhance social communication in older adults, working memory named as the executive component), 734718 CoBeN (MSCA-RISE - an MSCA scheme that is not an individual fellowship: visual working memory tasks in Parkinson's and Alzheimer's groups vs healthy controls). Both were surfaced by the unscoped pooled search on the question text. Non-embedding sweep over the survivors: regexp over objective + all report fields for (ageing|older adult|elderly|old age|age-related) returned exactly 657255, 703456, 749084, 843158; 703456's only hit is the aside quoted above. term_style exact-term: 'working memory', 'ageing', 'older adults' are the corpus's own words in all three gold texts, and lexical ranks all three inside the scoped top-5 (COMEDM 1, Motivageing 2, NeWMaBIL 5).
